title: Dataq Compass — Overview
meta_description: AI your model-risk committee approves and your regulator can inspect.

blocks.x: Dataq Compass — Overview in production terms — the runtime that holds it, the policies that bound it, the dashboards that prove it, and the quarterly delta your finance team can bank.

Dataq Compass operationalizes AI governance: the policy layer (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act mapping), model registry with technical documentation, evaluation puts to work with red-team suites, guardrail configuration, incident response for AI events, and the evidence pack that turns conformity assessment into a formality.

blocks.title: Dataq Compass — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: The design principle here is simple: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy across the Dataq Compass estate, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

blocks.x: What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: signals cross boundaries only through typed contracts across the enterprise, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.

Compass is where AI programs stop being risky: every model carries its model card, its evaluation results, its guardrail configuration and its control owner. High-risk use cases (credit scoring, employment, medical) get the documentation, human-oversight and post-market monitoring the EU AI Act actually requires — built in, not bolted on.

items: Regime mapping to controls and owners
Golden datasets, judge panels, red teams
PII, injection, topic fences as code

The build earns trust the same way every gate does: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases across the enterprise, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.
The part that survives audit is the boring part: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the enterprise, so a regression is a cohort, never an estate.

What holds the build together is discipline at the boundaries: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline across the Dataq Compass estate, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence.
